user_line_preserved: - Use TikZ to draw commutative diagrams, string diagrams, Young's tableaux, knots, braids, Temperley–Lieb algebra diagrams, quantum circuit diagrams, quantum logic gates, DFAs, NFAs, Turing machines, and other mathematical objects whenever and wherever appropriate. These diagrams must be fully and rigorously explained and justified. Keep their conventions compatible with the literature; rigorous proofs must not rely on diagrams.
